tools.name: detect_injection
tools.description: Screen untrusted input for prompt/tool injection, exfiltration, and obfuscation before an agent consumes it. Returns a verdict (clean|suspicious|attack), probability, bits-at-risk (upper bound on adversarial capture per the Adversarial Landauer bound), matched canon patterns, and a recommended actio

tools.name: detect_trace_tool_policy
tools.description: Analyze an agent trace for the Gray Swan Wave 16 class: untrusted retrieved/tool output causing a tool call outside the user-declared per-turn allowlist. Returns trace counts, unauthorized tool-call evidence, canon mapping VC-AI-TOOL-0001, and claim-boundary guardrails. Backed by T-IB-25/T-IB-29/T-I
